solution:
\(I = \int \frac{1}{4\left(x^2 + \frac{11}{4}\right)}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{1}{4} \int \frac{1}{x^2 + \left(\frac{\sqrt{11}}{2}\right)^2}\, dx\)
\(\because \int \frac{1}{x^2 + a^2}\, dx = \frac{1}{a}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{a}\right) + c\)
\(I = \frac{1}{4}\left[\frac{1}{\frac{\sqrt{11}}{2}}\right]\tan^{-1}\left[\frac{x}{\frac{\sqrt{11}}{2}}\right] + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{2\sqrt{11}}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{2x}{\sqrt{11}}\right) + c\)

\(I = \int \frac{1}{b^2\left(\frac{a^2}{b^2} - x^2\right)}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{1}{b^2} \int \frac{1}{\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^2 - x^2}\, dx\)
\(\because \int \frac{1}{a^2 - x^2}\, dx = \frac{1}{2a}\log\left(\frac{a + x}{a - x}\right) + c\)
\(I = \frac{1}{b^2} \cdot \frac{1}{2\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)} \log\left(\frac{\frac{a}{b} + x}{\frac{a}{b} - x}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{2ab}\log\left(\frac{a + bx}{a - bx}\right) + c\)

\(I = \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{3\left(x^2 - \frac{7}{3}\right)}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}\,\sqrt{x^2 - \left(\frac{\sqrt{7}}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2}}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2 - \left(\frac{\sqrt{7}}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2}}\, dx\)
\(\because \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2 - a^2}}\, dx = \log\left|x + \sqrt{x^2 - a^2}\right| + c\)
\(I = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\log\left(x + \sqrt{x^2 - \left(\frac{\sqrt{7}}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\log\left(x + \sqrt{x^2 - \frac{7}{3}}\right) + c\)

\(I = \int \frac{1}{x^2 + 8x + 16 - 4}\, dx\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{(x + 4)^2 - (2)^2}\, dx\)
\(\because \int \frac{1}{x^2 - a^2}\, dx = \frac{1}{2a}\log\left(\frac{x - a}{x + a}\right) + c\)
\(I = \frac{1}{2(2)}\log\left(\frac{(x + 4) - 2}{(x + 4) + 2}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{4}\log\left(\frac{x + 2}{x + 6}\right) + c\)

\(I = \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{3\left(x^2 - \frac{4}{3}x + \frac{2}{3}\right)}}\, dx\)
\(\because \left\{\left(\frac{1}{2}\text{ coefficient of } x\right)^2 = \left(\frac{1}{2}\left(-\frac{4}{3}\right)\right)^2 = \left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{4}{9}\right\}\)
\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2 - \frac{4}{3}x + \frac{4}{9} - \frac{4}{9} + \frac{2}{3}}}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{\left(x^2 - \frac{4}{3}x + \frac{4}{9}\right) + \left(\frac{2}{3} - \frac{4}{9}\right)}}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{\left(x - \frac{2}{3}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{3}\right)^2}}\, dx\)
\(\because \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2 + a^2}}\, dx = \log\left|x + \sqrt{x^2 + a^2}\right| + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\log\left(\left(x - \frac{2}{3}\right) + \sqrt{\left(x - \frac{2}{3}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{3}\right)^2}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\log\left(\left(x - \frac{2}{3}\right) + \sqrt{x^2 - \frac{4}{3}x + \frac{2}{3}}\right) + c\)

[Textbook misprint: in the printed solution the completing-the-square lines flip the middle-term sign (printing \(x^2-\frac{2}{5}x\) after the correct \(x^2+\frac{2}{5}x\)); the final answer \(\frac{1}{5}\log\left|\frac{1+5x}{3-5x}\right|+c\) is correct.]

\(I = \int \frac{1}{25\left(\frac{3}{25} - \frac{10}{25}x - x^2\right)}\, dx\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{25\left[\frac{3}{25} - \left(x^2 + \frac{2}{5}x\right)\right]}\, dx\)
\(\because \left\{\left(\frac{1}{2}\text{ coefficient of } x\right)^2 = \left(\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{2}{5}\right)\right)^2 = \left(\frac{1}{5}\right)^2 = \frac{1}{25}\right\}\)
\(= \frac{1}{25} \cdot \int \frac{1}{\frac{3}{25} - \left(x^2 - \frac{2}{5}x + \frac{1}{25} - \frac{1}{25}\right)}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{1}{25} \cdot \int \frac{1}{\frac{3}{25} - \left(x^2 - \frac{2}{5}x + \frac{1}{25}\right) + \frac{1}{25}}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{1}{25} \cdot \int \frac{1}{\frac{4}{25} - \left(x^2 - \frac{2}{5}x + \frac{1}{25}\right)}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{1}{25} \cdot \int \frac{1}{\left(\frac{2}{5}\right)^2 - \left(x - \frac{1}{5}\right)^2}\, dx\)
\(\because \int \frac{1}{a^2 - x^2}\, dx = \frac{1}{2a}\log\left(\frac{a + x}{a - x}\right) + c\)
\(I = \frac{1}{25} \cdot \frac{1}{2\left(\frac{2}{5}\right)} \cdot \log\left(\frac{\frac{2}{5} + \left(x - \frac{1}{5}\right)}{\frac{2}{5} - \left(x - \frac{1}{5}\right)}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{5} \cdot \log\left(\frac{1 + 5x}{3 - 5x}\right) + c\)

\(I = \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - \left(x^2 - x\right)}}\, dx\)
\(\because \left\{\left(\frac{1}{2}\text{ coefficient of } x\right)^2 = \left(\frac{1}{2}(-1)\right)^2 = \left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 = \frac{1}{4}\right\}\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - \left(x^2 - x + \frac{1}{4} - \frac{1}{4}\right)}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{\left(\frac{\sqrt{5}}{2}\right)^2 - \left(x - \frac{1}{2}\right)^2}}\, dx\)
\(\because \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{a^2 - x^2}}\, dx = \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{a}\right) + c\)
\(I = \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x - \frac{1}{2}}{\frac{\sqrt{5}}{2}}\right) + c\)
\(= \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{2x - 1}{\sqrt{5}}\right) + c\)

\(I = \int \frac{\sin 2x}{3\left(\sin^2 x\right)^2 - 4\left(\sin^2 x\right) + 1}\, dx\)
put \(\sin^2 x = t\) \(\therefore 2\sin x \cos x\, dx = dt\)
\(\therefore \sin 2x\, dx = dt\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{3t^2 - 4t + 1}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{3\left(t^2 - \frac{4}{3}t + \frac{1}{3}\right)}\, dt\)
\(\because \left\{\left(\frac{1}{2}\text{ coefficient of } t\right)^2 = \left(\frac{1}{2}\left(-\frac{4}{3}\right)\right)^2 = \left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{4}{9}\right\}\)
\(I = \frac{1}{3} \int \frac{1}{t^2 - \frac{4}{3}t + \frac{4}{9} - \frac{4}{9} + \frac{1}{3}}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{3} \int \frac{1}{\left(t^2 - \frac{4}{3}t + \frac{4}{9}\right) - \frac{1}{9}}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{3} \int \frac{1}{\left(t - \frac{2}{3}\right)^2 - \left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^2}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{2\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)} \log\left(\frac{\left(t - \frac{2}{3}\right) - \frac{1}{3}}{\left(t - \frac{2}{3}\right) + \frac{1}{3}}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{2}\log\left(\frac{3t - 3}{3t - 1}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{2}\log\left(\frac{3\sin^2 x - 3}{3\sin^2 x - 1}\right) + c\)
\(\therefore \int \frac{\sin 2x}{3\sin^4 x - 4\sin^2 x + 1}\, dx = \frac{1}{2}\log\left(\frac{3\sin^2 x - 3}{3\sin^2 x - 1}\right) + c\)

\(I = \int \frac{\sqrt{e^x}}{\sqrt{\frac{1}{e^x} - e^x}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \frac{\sqrt{e^x}}{\sqrt{\frac{1 - \left(e^x\right)^2}{e^x}}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \frac{\sqrt{e^x}}{\frac{\sqrt{1 - \left(e^x\right)^2}}{\sqrt{e^x}}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \frac{\sqrt{e^x} \cdot \sqrt{e^x}}{\sqrt{1 - \left(e^x\right)^2}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \frac{e^x}{\sqrt{1 - \left(e^x\right)^2}}\, dx\)
put \(e^x = t\)
\(\therefore e^x\, dx = dt\)
\(I = \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - t^2}}\, dt\)
\(= \sin^{-1}(t) + c\)
\(= \sin^{-1}\left(e^x\right) + c\)
\(\therefore \int \frac{e^{\frac{x}{2}}}{\sqrt{e^{-x} - e^{x}}}\, dx = \sin^{-1}\left(e^x\right) + c\)

\(I = \int \left(\sqrt{\tan x} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{\tan x}}\right) dx\)
\(= \int \frac{\tan x + 1}{\sqrt{\tan x}}\, dx\)
put \(\sqrt{\tan x} = t\) \(\therefore \tan x = t^2 \therefore x = \tan^{-1} t^2\)
\(\therefore dx = \frac{1}{1 + \left(t^2\right)^2} \cdot 2t\, dt\)
\(\because \sec^2 x\, dx = 2t\, dt\)
\(\therefore dx = \frac{2t}{\sec^2 x}\, dx = \frac{2t}{1 + \tan^2 x}\, dx = \frac{2t}{1 + t^4}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{t^2 + 1}{t} \cdot \frac{2t}{1 + t^4}\, dt = 2\int \frac{t^2 + 1}{t^4 + 1}\, dt\)
\(= 2\int \frac{1 + \frac{1}{t^2}}{t^2 + \frac{1}{t^2}}\, dt = 2\int \frac{\left(1 + \frac{1}{t^2}\right)}{\left(t - \frac{1}{t}\right)^2 + 2}\, dt\)
put \(t - \frac{1}{t} = u\) \(\because \left[\frac{d}{dt}\left(t - \frac{1}{t}\right) = 1 + \frac{1}{t^2}\right]\)
\(\therefore \left(t - \left(-\frac{1}{t^2}\right)\right) dt = du\)
\(\therefore \left(1 + \frac{1}{t^2}\right) dt = du\)
\(I = 2\int \frac{1}{u^2 + 2}\, du\)
\(= 2\int \frac{1}{u^2 + \left(\sqrt{2}\right)^2}\, du\)
\(= 2 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{u}{\sqrt{2}}\right) + c\)
\(= \sqrt{2}\,\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{t - \frac{1}{t}}{\sqrt{2}}\right) + c\)
\(= \sqrt{2}\,\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{t^2 - 1}{\sqrt{2}\,t}\right) + c\)
\(= \sqrt{2}\,\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\tan x - 1}{\sqrt{2} \cdot \sqrt{\tan x}}\right) + c\)

[Textbook misprint: the printed solution's denominator expansion shows \(5-5t^2-4-4t^2\) (should be \(5+5t^2-4+4t^2 = 9t^2+1\)) and the final answer prints \(\frac{2}{3}\tan^{-1}(2\tan\frac{x}{2})\) where the argument should be \(3\tan\frac{x}{2}\); the intended result is \(\frac{2}{3}\tan^{-1}\left(3\tan\frac{x}{2}\right)+c\).]

put \(\tan\frac{x}{2} = t\)
\(\therefore dx = \frac{2}{1 + t^2}\, dt\) and \(\cos x = \frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}\)
\(I = \int \frac{1\left(\frac{2}{1 + t^2}\right)}{5 - 4\left(\frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}\right)}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{\frac{2}{1 + t^2}}{\frac{5(1 + t^2) - 4(1 - t^2)}{1 + t^2}}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{2}{5 - 5t^2 - 4 - 4t^2}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{2}{9t^2 + 1}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{9\left(t^2 + \frac{1}{9}\right)}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{2}{9} \int \frac{1}{t^2 + \left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^2}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{2}{9} \cdot \frac{1}{\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{t}{\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{2}{3}\tan^{-1}(2t) + c\)
\(= \frac{2}{3}\tan^{-1}\left(2\tan\frac{x}{2}\right) + c\)
\(\therefore \int \frac{1}{5 - 4\cos x}\, dx = \frac{2}{3}\tan^{-1}\left(2\tan\frac{x}{2}\right) + c\)

put \(\tan x = t\)
\(\therefore dx = \frac{1}{1 + t^2}\, dt\) and \(\sin 2x = \frac{2t}{1 + t^2}\)
\(I = \int \frac{1\left(\frac{1}{1 + t^2}\right)}{2 - 3\left(\frac{2t}{1 + t^2}\right)}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{\frac{1}{1 + t^2}}{\frac{2(1 + t^2) - 3(2t)}{1 + t^2}}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{2 + 2t^2 - 6t}\, dt = \int \frac{1}{2(t^2 - 3t + 1)}\, dt\)
\(\because \left\{\left(\frac{1}{2}\text{ coefficient of } t\right)^2 = \left(\frac{1}{2}(-3)\right)^2 = \left(-\frac{3}{2}\right)^2 = \frac{9}{4}\right\}\)
\(= \frac{1}{2} \int \frac{1}{t^2 - 3t + \frac{9}{4} - \frac{9}{4} + 1}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{2} \int \frac{1}{\left(t^2 - 3t + \frac{9}{4}\right) - \frac{5}{4}}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{2} \int \frac{1}{\left(t - \frac{3}{2}\right)^2 - \left(\frac{\sqrt{5}}{2}\right)^2}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2\left(\frac{\sqrt{5}}{2}\right)} \log\left(\frac{\left(t - \frac{3}{2}\right) - \frac{\sqrt{5}}{2}}{\left(t - \frac{3}{2}\right) + \frac{\sqrt{5}}{2}}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{2\sqrt{5}}\log\left(\frac{2t - 3 - \sqrt{5}}{2t - 3 + \sqrt{5}}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{2\sqrt{5}}\log\left(\frac{2\tan x - 3 - \sqrt{5}}{2\tan x - 3 + \sqrt{5}}\right) + c\)

put \(\tan\frac{x}{2} = t\)
\(\therefore dx = \frac{2}{1 + t^2}\, dt\)
\(\therefore \sin x = \frac{2t}{1 + t^2}\) and \(\cos x = \frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}\)
\(I = \int \frac{1\left(\frac{2}{1 + t^2}\right)}{3 - 2\left(\frac{2t}{1 + t^2}\right) + 5\left(\frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}\right)}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{\frac{2}{1 + t^2}}{\frac{3(1 + t^2) - 2(2t) + 5(1 - t^2)}{1 + t^2}}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{2}{3 + 3t^2 - 4t + 5 - 5t^2}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{2}{8 - 4t - 2t^2}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{4 - 2t - t^2}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{4 - (t^2 + 2t)}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{4 - (t^2 + 2t + 1 - 1)}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{5 - (t^2 + 2t + 1)}\, dt\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{(\sqrt{5})^2 - (t + 1)^2}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{2(\sqrt{5})}\log\left(\frac{\sqrt{5} + (t + 1)}{\sqrt{5} - (t + 1)}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{2\sqrt{5}}\log\left(\frac{\sqrt{5} + 1 + \tan\frac{x}{2}}{\sqrt{5} - 1 - \tan\frac{x}{2}}\right) + c\)

[Textbook misprint: the printed solution writes \(\sin\theta=\frac{a}{\sqrt{a^2-b^2}}\), \(\cos\theta=\frac{b}{\sqrt{a^2-b^2}}\) (denominators should be \(\sqrt{a^2+b^2}\)) and gives the final angle as \(\frac{x}{2}+\frac{\pi}{6}\) where it should be \(\frac{x}{2}-\frac{\pi}{6}\); the Alternative-method result below is correct.]

Alternative method:
For any two positive numbers \(a\) and \(b\), we can find an angle \(\theta\), such that
\(\therefore \sin\theta = \frac{a}{\sqrt{a^2 - b^2}}\) and \(\cos\theta = \frac{b}{\sqrt{a^2 - b^2}}\)
Using this we express \(\sin x - \sqrt{3}\cos x\)
\(= \sqrt{1 + 3}\left(\cos\theta \cdot \sin x - \sin\theta \cdot \cos x\right)\)
\(= 2\sin(x - \theta)\)
\(= 2\sin\left(x - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)\)
\(\therefore I = \int \frac{1}{2 \cdot \sin\left(x - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{1}{2}\int \csc\left(x - \frac{\pi}{3}\right) dx\)
\(= \frac{1}{2}\log\left(\csc\left(x - \frac{\pi}{3}\right) - \cot\left(x - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{2}\log\left(\tan\left(\frac{x}{2} + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)\right) + c\)

Divide Numerator and Denominator by \(\cos^2 x\)
\(I = \int \frac{\frac{1}{\cos^2 x}}{\frac{3 + 2\sin^2 x + 5\cos^2 x}{\cos^2 x}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \frac{\sec^2 x}{3\sec^2 x + 2\tan^2 x + 5}\, dx\)
\(= \int \frac{\sec^2 x}{3(1 + \tan^2 x) + 2\tan^2 x + 5}\, dx\)
\(= \int \frac{\sec^2 x}{5\tan^2 x + 8}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{1}{5} \cdot \int \frac{\sec^2 x}{\tan^2 x + \frac{8}{5}}\, dx\)
put \(\tan x = t\) \(\therefore \sec^2 x\, dx = dt\)
\(I = \frac{1}{5} \int \frac{1}{t^2 + \frac{8}{5}}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{5} \int \frac{1}{t^2 + \left(\frac{\sqrt{8}}{\sqrt{5}}\right)^2}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{5} \cdot \frac{1}{\frac{\sqrt{8}}{\sqrt{5}}}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{t}{\frac{\sqrt{8}}{\sqrt{5}}}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{5}\,t}{2\sqrt{2}}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{2\sqrt{10}}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{5}\,\tan x}{2\sqrt{2}}\right) + c\)
\(\therefore \int \frac{1}{3 + 2\sin^2 x + 5\cos^2 x}\, dx = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{10}}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{5}\,\tan x}{2\sqrt{2}}\right) + c\)

\(I = \int \frac{\cos\theta}{4\cos^3\theta - 3\cos\theta}\, d\theta\)
\(= \int \frac{1}{4\cos^2\theta - 3}\, d\theta\)
Divide Numerator and Denominator by \(\cos^2\theta\)
\(I = \int \frac{\frac{1}{\cos^2\theta}}{\frac{4\cos^2\theta - 3}{\cos^2\theta}}\, d\theta\)
\(= \int \frac{\sec^2\theta}{4 - 3\sec^2\theta}\, d\theta\)
\(= \int \frac{\sec^2\theta}{4 - 3(1 + \tan^2\theta)}\, d\theta\)
\(= \int \frac{\sec^2\theta}{1 - 3\tan^2\theta}\, d\theta\)
put \(\tan\theta = t\) \(\therefore \sec^2\theta\, d\theta = dt\)
\(I = \int \frac{1}{1 - 3t^2}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{3} \cdot \int \frac{1}{\frac{1}{3} - t^2}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{3} \cdot \int \frac{1}{\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2 - t^2}\, dt\)
\(= \frac{1}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{2\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)} \log\left(\frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} + t}{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} - t}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{2\sqrt{3}}\log\left(\frac{1 + \sqrt{3}\,t}{1 - \sqrt{3}\,t}\right) + c\)
\(= \frac{1}{2\sqrt{3}}\log\left(\frac{1 + \sqrt{3}\,\tan\theta}{1 - \sqrt{3}\,\tan\theta}\right) + c\)
\(\therefore \int \frac{\cos\theta}{\cos 3\theta}\, d\theta = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{3}}\log\left(\frac{1 + \sqrt{3}\,\tan\theta}{1 - \sqrt{3}\,\tan\theta}\right) + c\)
